name: language-contains-module
body:
Every `Module` node is contained by the `Language` node for the language it was scanned under: `Language —Contains→ Module` is wired ingestor-side, so a module's parent is its language node. The `Contains` rel table gains the `(Language, Module)` pair (write-time validation already restricts `Contains` pairs), and module insertion in the ingestor attaches each module to its language root exactly once.

Existing Module→Module containment (Rust nested modules, Java sub-packages, Go sub-packages, C++ namespaces, TS file namespaces) is unchanged in shape — it now hangs under a rooted module FQN, beneath the Language root. A module with no language root is a defect.

Acceptance: `MATCH (l:Language)-[:Contains]->(m:Module) RETURN l.fqn, m.fqn` returns every Module exactly once under its own language; no Module node exists without an incoming `Contains` from a Language; the `Contains` pair `(Language, Module)` is declared in the DB schema so the edge is not silently dropped; nested module containment still holds under the rooted FQNs.
